status: PRE-REGISTERED - runs only AFTER the Tier 1 maiden run has written its verdict to Cross_Market_Titans.md

tier1_unchanged.rule: Ruling 74-2: the Tier 1 bar and gate are not moved, relaxed or amended by anything below.

why: The macro family mixes exogenous policy questions (Fed decisions) with crypto milestone questions ('Will the price of Bitcoin be above $80,000 on September 5?') whose probability moves BECAUSE BTC moved. Pooled, the mechanical group dominates the correlation, and any lead it shows can be the watcher's 5-minute poll latency rather than prediction.

fed-rates.filter: drop question label `sport` == FED-RATES (the Gamma tag it was fetched under)
fed-rates.role: exogenous: a policy repricing that BTC may or may not follow

crypto.role: endogenous: the question is a function of the BTC price
crypto.reading: a peak with |lag| <= 5 min (POLL_INTERVAL_MINUTES) is 'contemporaneous repricing within the poll interval: latency, not a lead'; only a peak OUTSIDE the poll interval that clears the bar may be called a lead

bars.insufficient_rule: a subfamily under min_events or min_points is 'insufficient', not a verdict

state_at_registration.note: counts only: NO subfamily correlation was run before registering. The Tier 1 preview of 2026-09-05 (macro pooled, forced, 8-hour partial series) read corr -0.195 at -33 min; that number was seen before this registration and is recorded here for honesty, not used to set a bar.

caveats: collect_live_questions dedupes by token with FIRST TAG WINS; the launcher fetches crypto before fed-rates, so a market carrying both tags is labelled CRYPTO.
Drop records carry no tag_slug field; the label lives in `sport` (Round 52 category labelling).
The two subfamilies share the BTC return series, so their results are not independent tests.
